premises.text: Many adults are unwilling to try new activities due to fear of making mistakes in public settings
premises.evidence_span: approximately 28 million people aren't willing to try new things like yoga, but are looking for the right introductory way to get there

premises.text: Motion capture technology can provide individualized instruction for learning activities
premises.evidence_span: uses motion capture technology like the Microsoft Connect to give you the individualized instruction you need to learn any major muscle movement-based activity

premises.text: Kenobi provides a platform for users to learn at their own pace without embarrassment
premises.evidence_span: I can fail over and over and over again and never be embarrassed, never worry about who's looking at me or who's going to laugh

premises.text: Content creators can partner with Kenobi to provide instructional material and share revenue
premises.evidence_span: we partner with premium content creators, such as yoga instructors, to put content on our platform and engage in a revenue share with them

value.text: Users gain confidence to learn new activities through personalized instruction
value.evidence_span: this is a place where instructors can come and provide high-quality content

notes: No separate premises for the technology requirements as they are part of the platform's offering.
